findings.detail: All sixteen actual metadata statuses are preserved; canonical snapshot calls them executed_partial. Do not present the executed count as metadata-complete or formal runs.

Builder references product meta SHA and cache raw responses; this audit separately checks product stdout/stderr/prompt hashes. A meta SHA is not itself an assertion that native raw artifact SHA was recomputed by builder.
Aware local generated_at is nonfuture, later than all recorded finishes and near file mtime. No NTP/trusted timestamp proof; producer durations and finish definitions remain product-specific.

Six actual request pairs checked. fresh/repeat are planned labels; zero selected read is not proof of absolute cold cache or no creation; missing named creation counter is not provider-wide no-creation or billing evidence.
WB first-slot original reason says batch zero sends at that moment; do not extend that historical sentence to the later four WB executed slots or global zeroAPI.
